P1.name: Dead Unit
P1.description: Follow when the radio set fails to turn ON

p1_s1.question: Check the battery voltage. Is the battery sufficiently charged?

p1_charge.action: Charge the battery fully, then retry powering on the unit.

p1_s2.question: Measure voltage at test point TP 34. Does it read ~7.4V (nominal battery voltage)?

p1_battery_conn.action: Battery voltage absent at TP 34. Check and reseat the battery connector/contacts.

p1_s3.question: Check voltage rails at TP 35 and TP 36. Do you read 3.6V at TP 35 AND 5V at TP 36?

p1_u24.action: Voltage rails at TP 35 / TP 36 are absent or incorrect. Component U24 is faulty — replace it.

p1_s4.question: Check voltage at resistor R55. Is the 3.3V logic supply line present?

p1_r55_down.question: 3.3V absent at R55. Does the screen remain unresponsive even after tracing downstream components?

p1_u29.action: 3.3V line present but unit still dead. U29 component is faulty — replace it.

p1_display.action: Core power rails valid but screen unresponsive. Validate the display assembly using a specialized test jig. Replace display if faulty.

P2.name: BITE Module Check
P2.description: Used to check failure of any module via internal diagnostics

p2_init.question: Connect battery and antenna. Power ON the radio and navigate to Menu -> iBITE. Is iBITE selected and running?

p2_power_first.action: Unit must power on before running BITE. Run Procedure P1 (Dead Unit) first.

p2_bb_fail.action: BB check failed. Reprogram the SCT in the Baseband card. If fault persists, replace the Baseband card.

p2_rf_fail.component: RF Path / RTC / SPI Flash (SM Card)
p2_rf_fail.action: RF check failed. Check the RF path and reprogram SCT. RTC or SPI Flash in SM Card may be faulty.

p2_fpga.action: F:1 indicates FPGA fault. The FPGA in the SM Card is faulty — replace the SM Card.

p2_spi.action: S:1 indicates SPI Flash fault. The SPI Flash in the SM Card is faulty — replace the SM Card.

p2_rtc.action: R:1 indicates RTC fault. The RTC in the SM Card is faulty — replace the SM Card.

p2_pass.action: BITE check complete. No active module faults detected. Built-in diagnostics passed.

P3.name: Display / Keypad
P3.description: Locates faults related to display errors or keypad input

p3_s1.question: Connect battery and antenna, then power ON the radio. Does the radio power on?

p3_dead.action: Run Procedure P1 (Dead Unit) first — unit must power on before diagnosing display/keypad.

p3_s2.question: Does the display show proper characters?

p3_s3.question: Is the display showing missing or unwanted/garbled characters?

p3_display_fault.action: Check proper connection of the display cable. If connection is good, the display is faulty — replace the display assembly.

p3_s4.question: Navigate to Menu -> Message -> Compose and test all keys. Is digit display proper when keys are pressed?

p3_keypad.action: Digit display incorrect on keypress. Keypad or Keypad Cable is faulty — check cable connection, then replace keypad if needed.

p3_ok.action: Keypad and Display are confirmed fully functional.

P4.name: Receiver (Rx) Path
P4.description: Followed whenever there is no reception in the radio set

p4_s2.question: Switch ON radio and enable the RF channel. Is the RSSI indicator displayed?

p4_audio.question: RSSI is present. Check audio signal at capacitor C21. Is audio present at C21?

p4_speaker.action: Audio signal present at C21 but no output. The Speaker is faulty — replace the speaker assembly.

p4_u4_rx.action: RSSI present but no audio at C21. U4 is faulty — replace it.

p4_s3.question: No RSSI. Check Local Oscillator frequency at capacitor C114. Is the L.O. frequency correct (should be double the channel frequency)?

p4_s4.question: L.O. frequency incorrect. Check for 38.4 MHz master clock at U38. Is 38.4 MHz present at U38?

p4_tcxo.action: Master clock at U38 absent/incorrect. The TCXO is faulty — replace the TCXO.

p4_trace.action: 38.4 MHz present at U38 but L.O. is wrong. Evaluate the local oscillator trace and downstream components for fault.

p4_s5.question: L.O. is correct. Check voltage at inductor L37. Is the voltage reading 1.2V?

p4_u4.action: Voltage at L37 correct (1.2V) but no reception. U4 is faulty — replace it.

p4_u21.action: Voltage at L37 absent/incorrect. U21 voltage regulator is faulty — replace it.

P5.name: Transmitter (Tx) Path
P5.description: Followed whenever there is a transmission problem

p5_s1.question: Press the PTT switch and observe the status LED. Does the RED LED glow when PTT is pressed?

p5_a2.question: [Branch A] Red LED does not glow. Check SW 5 — does it short when PTT is pressed?

p5_sw5.action: SW 5 does not short on PTT press. SW 5 is faulty — replace the PTT switch.

p5_a3.question: [Branch A] Check for toggling signal at R248 when PTT is pressed. Is there toggling?

p5_ctrl.action: No toggling at R248 on PTT press. Controller (MCU) is faulty — replace the baseband/controller card.

p5_a4.question: [Branch A] Check voltage at L37. Is it reading 1.2V?

p5_u4_a.action: Voltage at L37 is 1.2V but LED still not glowing. U4 is faulty — replace it.

p5_u21_a.action: Voltage at L37 incorrect. U21 voltage regulator is faulty — replace it.

p5_b5.question: [Branch B] Red LED glows (PTT active). Check for 38.4 MHz signal at inductor L42. Is it present?

p5_u38.action: 38.4 MHz absent at L42. U38 is faulty — replace it.

p5_b6.question: [Branch B] Check for toggling signal at R179 when PTT is pressed. Is there toggling?

p5_u4_b.action: No toggling at R179 on PTT. U4 is faulty — replace it.

p5_pass.action: All specified diagnostic checks passed. Evaluate secondary downstream matching network blocks for further RF power issues.
